intent: Teach first job without assuming present employment; work as uncountable activity and bounded comparison; worker demonstrated stopping; habitual soil check before planting; driver waiting until everyone seated without invented departure; pilot explanation without invented cause; boat tied to post; tested bridge model without claiming success.
picturePurpose: Five original coded scenes, one source-specific action order, one exact evidence subset, and original three-dimensional bridge-model versus flat-plan art. Original and21,053B derivative actually opened; phone targets and all rendered/application checks pending.

transfer.stem: 换成书店、计划和导游，哪组三句完整保留了信息？
transfer.passage:
三条新信息
他的第一份工作在一家小书店。仔细做计划比赶进度更重要。导游一直等到所有人都准备好了。
词语提示：planning 做计划；guide 导游；ready 准备好的。

options.text: His first job was in a small bookshop. Careful planning matters more than rushing. The guide waited until everyone was ready.
His later job was in a small bookshop. Careful planning matters more than rushing. The guide waited until everyone was ready.
His first job was in a small bookshop. Rushing matters more than careful planning. The guide waited until everyone was ready.
His first job was in a small bookshop. Careful planning matters more than rushing. The guide waited until some people were ready.

answer.display: His first job was in a small bookshop. Careful planning matters more than rushing. The guide waited until everyone was ready.

explanation.strategy: 分别核对first的时间位置、比较方向、until的终点和everyone的范围。

steps.text: 第一份工作在小书店：His first job was in a small bookshop。
steps.reason: first是第一份，不能换成later后来的；原句没有交代现在的工作。

steps.text: 仔细做计划更重要：Careful planning matters more than rushing。
steps.reason: careful planning在比较中更重要，不能把方向颠倒。

steps.text: 等到所有人准备好：waited until everyone was ready。
steps.reason: until保留等待终点，everyone不能缩成some；也不补等待时长或随后离开。

distractors.reason: later把第一份工作改成了后来的工作。
把仔细做计划与赶进度的重要性比较颠倒了。
some把所有人的范围缩成了部分人。

explanation.pitfall: 职业名词之外，first、more than、until和everyone也决定句意；别凭常识补后续。

visual.title: 时间、比较、终点
visual.caption: 保留原句的顺序、方向和范围，不补未给出的结果。
